expedition: Seascape Alaska 5: Gulf of Alaska Remotely Operated Vehicle Exploration and Mapping
purpose: The dive site is an isolated ridge located on the mid-slope at depths of about 1650-1800 m on the Aleutian Subduction Zone, about 50 km southwest of Middleton Island. The ridge is one of many that lie on the middle and lower slope, inboard of the deformation front, that result from folding and faulting in the upper plate. Exploration of this ridge will provide information on the age and lithology of the sediments of the accretionary wedge, and the effects of severe shaking from large earthquakes.
